qualifier: cranial ganglia and olfactory/GnRH migration rather than spinal or peripheral
name: Brainstem and cranial nerve development
rationale: Members cover hindbrain/pons development, cranial nerves (facial, trigeminal, olfactory), cranial ganglia and related neuronal migration, distinguishing the theme from spinal, enteric and dorsal root ganglion confusables.

name: Vitamin D–FGF23–PTH axis in bone mineralization
rationale: Members span vitamin D activation/inactivation and its disorders, FGF23-Klotho and PTH responses, and regulation of bone mineralization, unlike confusables centred on vitamin K, phosphate transporters or tooth mineralization.

name: Methionine–folate one-carbon cycle and selenium methylation
rationale: Members cover methionine/SAM cycle and salvage, folate interconversion and transport with their inborn errors, plus selenocompound metabolism that separates the theme from transsulfuration and B-vitamin confusables.

name: Eye morphogenesis and placental trophoblast development
rationale: Members combine lens, retinal vasculature and anterior eye development with trophoblast, labyrinth and decidual placental processes; the placental component distinguishes it from purely ocular/retinal confusables.

qualifier: preinitiation complex assembly and pause release, non-viral
name: RNA polymerase II preinitiation-to-elongation transition control
rationale: Members cover PIC assembly, promoter clearance, pausing and elongation complex formation, while confusables add HIV/Tat elongation and capping.

qualifier: with Golgi vesicle targeting and tethering
name: Rab/ARF GTPase cycle and Golgi vesicle tethering
rationale: Members cover Rab prenylation, GEF/GAP control and ARF signalling plus vesicle targeting/tethering to the Golgi, unlike confusables focused on COPI/COPII coats or Golgi organization.

name: Parallel actin bundles in stereocilia and microvilli
rationale: All members concern parallel actin bundles building cochlear hair-cell stereocilia or brush-border microvilli, distinct from ear morphogenesis, vestibular and eye confusables.

name: Dolichol-linked N-glycan synthesis and congenital glycosylation disorders
rationale: Members cover GDP-mannose and dolichol-phosphate sugar donors, ALG-mediated oligosaccharide assembly and N-glycan processing with their CDG defects, unlike GPI-anchor or nucleotide-sugar transport confusables.

qualifier: fluid shear, hydrostatic pressure and membrane stress
name: Mechanosensing of fluid shear, pressure and membrane stress
rationale: Members are responses to mechanical forces (PIEZO1 shear and load signalling, hydrostatic pressure, cell volume, blebbing, membrane repair), unlike eNOS, SRF and tight-junction confusables.

name: Pyrimidine deoxynucleotide synthesis via salvage
rationale: Members cover pyrimidine salvage and deoxynucleotide/dTTP synthesis, versus confusables on de novo pyrimidine synthesis or (deoxy)nucleotide catabolism.

qualifier: with glycine conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Glycine–alanine–threonine metabolism and aromatic acid conjugation
rationale: Members cover alanine, threonine, glycine and glyoxylate metabolism plus glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, unlike proline, glutamate or sulfur amino acid confusables.

name: Base excision repair gap filling and mitochondrial DNA repair
rationale: Members concern AP-site resolution and short/long-patch BER synthesis plus mitochondrial DNA repair, which distinguishes the theme from broad DNA repair and editing confusables.

qualifier: tight-junction paracellular Mg2+ with Na+/K+ handling
name: Tight-junction paracellular and renal Na+, K+, Mg2+ transport
rationale: Members cover regulation of sodium, potassium and magnesium transport with tight-junction paracellular transport and calcium-independent adhesion, unlike chloride cotransporter, P-type ATPase and osmotic confusables.

qualifier: common gamma-chain, IL-12 and IL-10 families
name: Interleukin JAK–STAT signaling: gamma-chain, IL-12 and IL-10 families
rationale: Members are signalling by IL-2/7/9/15/21, IL-12/23/27/35, IL-10/20 and IL-3/5 with STAT control and NK regulation; the IL-12 and IL-10 families distinguish it from IL-2/TCR and IL-6 confusables.

name: Reactive oxygen species detoxification and redox homeostasis
rationale: All three members concern ROS detoxification and cellular redox balance, versus confusables on ascorbate, nitrosative stress, selenium or metal responses.

core: Striated muscle growth and differentiation control
qualifier: skeletal and cardiac myogenesis and regeneration
name: Skeletal and cardiac myogenesis, regeneration and growth control
rationale: Members regulate myoblast proliferation, differentiation and fusion, satellite cell regeneration, atrophy/hypertrophy and cardiomyocyte growth, unlike calcineurin, contraction or extraocular muscle confusables.

name: Lung, trachea and diaphragm development through pneumocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover lung branching, mesenchyme, lobes, saccules, pneumocytes, trachea and diaphragm, versus confusables on surfactant, salivary or pancreatic/kidney branching.

qualifier: DSCAM, Sidekick and nectin with receptor tyrosine phosphatases
name: Neuronal adhesion via DSCAM, Sidekick, nectins and RPTPs
rationale: Members concern homophilic/heterophilic neuronal adhesion (DSCAM, SDK, nectin, RPTP signalling, dendrite self-avoidance), unlike L1-family/node of Ranvier or retinal confusables.

name: Regulation of prostaglandin synthesis and arachidonate release
rationale: All members regulate prostaglandin biosynthesis/secretion or arachidonate release, rather than the COX reactions or prostanoid receptors of the confusables.

name: Purine nucleoside and nucleoside-analog drug membrane transport
rationale: Members cover nucleoside/nucleobase transporters and xenobiotic transport of nucleoside drugs (abacavir, ribavirin), unlike nucleotide interconversion and drug catabolism confusables.

name: Proton-coupled di/oligopeptide and histidine transport
rationale: Members concern proton/oligopeptide cotransport, dipeptide, histidine and vacuolar transport, versus confusables on neutral/cationic amino acid transporters and histamine.

name: G2/M transition and its DREAM–p53 transcriptional control
rationale: Members cover G2/M cyclin, PLK and MASTL events, G2 checkpoint and DREAM/p53-repressed cell cycle genes, unlike APC/C mitotic exit, G1/S E2F and DNA-damage confusables.

qualifier: and miRNA control of specific target translation
name: Regulation of miRNA biogenesis, turnover and target translation
rationale: Members regulate miRNA transcription, processing and degradation and miRNA control of particular targets, whereas confusables centre on RISC silencing machinery and mRNA decay.

name: Oncogenic RTK mutants, kinase-inhibitor resistance and STAT5 signaling
rationale: Members are cancer mutants/fusions of KIT, FLT3, PDGFR, ERBB2, ALK and FGFR with drug resistance plus EPO/TPO/IL-3 STAT5 signalling, unlike wild-type RTK, MET or interleukin confusables.

qualifier: with Notch/TSR O-fucose and O-glucose glycosylation
name: Glycosaminoglycan synthesis and Notch O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation
rationale: Members cover proteoglycan linkage, HS/CS/DS/KS chain synthesis and their genetic defects plus O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation of Notch and TSR proteins, unlike O-mannose, N-glycan or sulfate-transporter confusables.
